fact: On 4 August 2026 the ADN gave the closing assessment of the Plan National du Numérique: 64% operationalised, 17 of 44 started projects completed and 27 operational, with a public funding deficit cited.
title: Validation de la SNIA et du PSEN : l'ADN promet d'accompagner la mise en oeuvre de la nouvelle feuille de route numérique de la RDC
